passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: Hello, my name is Mina, and I am from Korea.
phrases.ko: 안녕, 내 이름은 미나이고, 나는 한국에서 왔어요.
phrases.zh: 你好，我叫米娜，我来自韩国。
phrases.py: nǐ hǎo， wǒ jiào mǐ nà， wǒ lái zì hán guó。

phrases.en: I live in Seoul with my family.
phrases.py: wǒ hé jiā rén zhù zài shǒu ěr。

phrases.en: I am a student, and I go to school every day.
phrases.py: wǒ shì xué shēng， měi tiān qù shàng xué。

phrases.en: I am in the sixth grade.
I am in Class Three at my school.
phrases.py: wǒ zài xué xiào shàng sān bān。

phrases.en: My school is near my home, so I walk there.
phrases.ko: 학교는 집 가까이에 있어서 걸어서 가요.
phrases.zh: 学校离我家很近，所以我走着去。
phrases.py: xué xiào lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn， suǒ yǐ wǒ zǒu zhe qù。

phrases.en: I have a little sister, and she is eleven.
phrases.ko: 나에게는 여동생이 있고, 동생은 열한 살이에요.
phrases.zh: 我有一个妹妹，她十一岁。
phrases.py: wǒ yǒu yí gè mèi mèi， tā shí yī suì。

phrases.en: I like English, and I like to meet new friends.
phrases.ko: 나는 영어를 좋아하고, 새 친구를 만나는 것도 좋아해요.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢英语，也喜欢认识新朋友。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān yīng yǔ， yě xǐ huān rèn shí xīn péng yǒu。

phrases.en: I am happy to meet you.
phrases.py: jiàn dào nǐ wǒ hěn gāo xìng。

phrases.en: This is my short hello from Seoul.
phrases.zh: 这是我从首尔送来的一句短短的问候。
phrases.py: zhè shì wǒ cóng shǒu ěr sòng lái de yī jù duǎn duǎn de wèn hòu。

full_passage_spoken: Hello, my name is Mina, and I am from Korea. I live in Seoul with my family. I am a student, and I go to school every day. I am in the sixth grade. I am in Class Three at my school. My school is near my home, so I walk there. I am thirteen years old. I have a little sister, and she is eleven. I like English, and I like to meet new friends. I am happy to meet you. This is my short hello from Seoul.
full_passage_zh: 你好，我叫米娜，我来自韩国。我和家人住在首尔。我是学生，每天去上学。我上六年级。我在学校上三班。学校离我家很近，所以我走着去。我十三岁。我有一个妹妹，她十一岁。我喜欢英语，也喜欢认识新朋友。见到你我很高兴。这是我从首尔送来的一句短短的问候。
